body: Edit reels from your phone with a Telegram bot: stop editing at a desk.

I drop raw clips in Google Drive, a Hermes bot picks them up and runs my Claude video-editing skill, 3 reels at once. Telegram pings me the time left, and if I don't like one I text back and it re-edits. The catch: my PC has to stay on.

I'm Manraj Sidhu, AI developer, and this is the real setup.
